title: Taylor Green Vortex
summary: Compressible turbulence demonstration cases using high order methods.

title: Scramjet fuel injection
summary: Investigate compressible mixing and ignition in scramjet flows, including sensitivity to injector placement, wall effects, and shock-induced flow structures.

title: Agentic AI mesh generation for hypersonic simulations
summary: Develop AI-assisted workflows for meshing and discretization of high-speed aerodynamic configurations with complex geometry and physics coupling.

title: Strut-based fuel injection
summary: Study shock-shear-layer-recirculation coupling, strut geometry dependence, and performance implications for inlet and combustor integration.

title: Adapting chemistry to floating-point precision on GPU hardware
summary: Explore methods for reduced and mixed precision chemistry integration on GPUs while preserving robust physical behavior and performance.

title: Embedded ML for partial differential equations
summary: Develop learned components and surrogate strategies that maintain physical consistency while accelerating large-scale simulation workflows.

title: Adjoint-based optimization for chemically reacting flows
summary: Optimize inflow conditions and design variables in reacting systems using differentiable simulation and uncertainty-aware methods.

title: Rotating detonation engines
summary: Understand wave propagation, detonation chemistry, chamber coupling, and engine performance in rotating detonation combustors.

title: Detonation wall interaction
summary: Develop understanding of wall effects on detonation propagation, both from a cooling perspective and from introduced instabilities.

title: Solid-fuel ramjet combustion
summary: Study surface regression, solid-fuel pyrolysis, and coupled flame structures under demanding high-speed operating conditions.
